scope: Audit of V4 source dates and user-created V3 artwork against the current V5 timeline data. This file records recommendations and data-level alignment only; it does not claim Unity validation.

chronology_guardrails.note: Do not move this cue earlier merely because the editor product label says 2019. Unity's official archive dates Unity 2019.4.0f1 to 2020-06-07; a product version year is not the event date. The source frame establishes the version label, not when this screenshot was captured or used.
chronology_guardrails.recommendation: Keep its event date unassigned until the source video's depicted date is independently established.

chronology_guardrails.note: Several source frames carry no verified year. Do not infer dates from download/capture time or product-version naming alone.

memory_overload_policy.note: This group deliberately reuses source-pool indices as memory fragments during information overload. It is not a claim that all source items are contemporaneous. The exact chronological cue windows above should remain separately identifiable.

user_art_review.reason: The monochrome two-panel drawing and paired Japanese/Chinese dialogue directly explain translation work; it reads as a user-authored example, not a false archive screenshot. Preserve the art and retain its provenance as newly authored content.

The clean, Chinese-lettered, and proofread states form a readable continuous workflow. Keep them as the film's authored translation demonstration, not as a scan of a published manga or historical team page.

user_art_review.source_file: art/source/fullfilm-v3-user-images/霓虹像素星辰六格动画分镜.png
user_art_review.reason: The six-frame sequence is useful original animation, while the saturated neon glow and crisp generated-looking window motif clash with the early-web pages. Reuse it as a present-day remake/animation example, not as a recovered Flash file.

user_art_review.source_file: art/source/fullfilm-v3-user-images/原文与中文译文：月下古桥奇境.png
user_art_review.reason: The side-by-side localization is useful, but the polished fantasy CG is contemporary original concept art, not a documented old game screenshot. Keep it only as a modern creator's translation example.

The ornate nautical illustration is contemporary original art and the page chrome is a stylized mock homepage. The labels are readable, but the image should not stand in for a real early-2000s personal site.

The cute painterly cats and brightly colored rounded cards are visibly contemporary. Remove the four early appearances among historical forum/fansub artifacts; retain the set in the later return/share sequence as newly made community stickers.

This is a modern creator-desk still life and already appears after the silence/recreation turn. Keep it as atmosphere; the monitor art is not real software evidence and should not be treated as a screenshot.

The image is explicitly used as an imagined concept after the silence, which fits. Its bridge direction, canopy/arch placement, and seating do not match the actual blockout, so exclude it from any claim that it depicts the built world.

visual_review.ai_attribution_note: Disposition is based on visible style and the documented use of each asset. The source records establish original user artwork, but do not establish the image-generation method; this audit does not infer authorship from appearance alone.
visual_review.unity_validation: Not performed by this audit. All seconds above are derived from local timeline JSON and C# sampling logic.
